reply.summary: Vatumta is a pint-sized red-eyed ape with silvery fur who lounges in a villains' clubhouse and glowers at everyone's snacks. Vatumta is stronger than he looks and holds a deep grudge against anyone who laughs at his small stature.

feats.scene: Vatumta bats a toy-box lid across the clubhouse floor.
Vatumta tumbles off a shelf onto a pile of cushions and sulks.

reply.summary: Letel is a green-skinned, red-eyed female ring bearer from a world where her kind were bred like livestock, chosen for her unbreakable spirit. Letel is a rookie who builds glowing shapes, shields allies and flies between stars, but her first diplomatic mission fails.

feats.scene: Letel conjures a glowing wall that blocks two warring fleets' crossfire for a moment.
Letel absorbs a stray volley on a ring shield and tumbles back.

reply.summary: Eonsianu is a brown-haired bull-headed bodyguard, grim and doubtful, created in a hidden laboratory and raised on an island of beast-people. Eonsianu distrusts rumours, keeps his counsel and follows his companions into exile.

feats.scene: Eonsianu charges a stockade gate and splinters it with his horns.
Eonsianu shrugs off a bolt from a crossbow aimed at his chest.

reply.summary: Tesirne is a bald despot with a single eye who usurped the throne of a hidden walled city, inventing gadgets and a serum that turns thugs into pointy-eared rodent-men. Tesirne flees to new cities whenever his plots collapse.

feats.scene: Tesirne hurls a dagger that trips a hidden lever and drops a killer into a pit.
Tesirne slips out of a collapsing vault with only bruises.

reply.summary: Numseovi is an American schemer who conjures illusions to fool teenage heroes and slips away behind a haze of false images. Numseovi has no great strength, and relies on trickery and sleight of hand.

feats.scene: Numseovi sets off a smoke charge in a crowded museum hall.
Numseovi crashes through a display case and keeps running.

reply.summary: Lline is a tall red-skinned demon who poses as a rock star, performing in different fashions to lure teenagers toward apathy and violence. Lline steals rejuvenation formulas for a hidden mistress and sheds every disguise when cornered.

feats.scene: Lline whips a stadium crowd into a riot with a single wailing chord.
Lline stands up from a crushed stage truss and shakes dust off his sleeves.

reply.summary: Riavalar is a dark-haired, dark-eyed janitor and amateur drummer who shares a gloomy outlook on holidays and falls into a sweet first date at an arcade. Riavalar is shy, kind, and holds flowers behind his back when embarrassed.

feats.scene: Riavalar hits a drum fill so hard a stick snaps in half.
Riavalar is knocked off a stool by a crashing hero and stands back up.

reply.summary: Lluleses is an orange-haired senior officer in a wartime command bunker, poring over maps while enemy armies close in. Lluleses watches a relic being unveiled and plots with the others to turn the war around.

feats.scene: Lluleses slams a fist on a map table to end a heated argument.
Lluleses sits through a shaking bombardment without leaving his chair.

reply.summary: Rnucoro is a pink, eyeless, liquid-bodied lantern who trained himself to slip through any bars and think clearly with a fluid brain. Rnucoro commands a ring that shapes light into tools, shields and beams, and flies on its power.

feats.scene: Rnucoro pours himself through a cell grating and builds a glowing ram to smash the door behind him.
Rnucoro soaks a blast and flows back together intact.

reply.summary: Anili is a blue-eyed engineer and gang boss from an old alien world, who builds helmets that command police robots and lost a vote to a rival inventor. Anili swears revenge from exile, and is a fine scientist and a poor loser.

feats.scene: Anili commands an army of machines to storm the council hall.
Anili is thrown from his console and shaken by an unstable android.

reply.summary: Soiuti is a black-haired soldier-spy from a militaristic planet who swallowed an experimental pill and joined a band of heroes as a mole. Soiuti makes zones of total darkness that swallow all light, and is easily outwitted by the very team he infiltrates.

feats.scene: Soiuti smothers an entire hangar in blackness so no one can see.
Soiuti is snared at the end of the ruse and shrugs off the capture nets.

reply.summary: Tienu is a black-haired petty thief who hears an imaginary voice in a quake and later dons a mask to pose as a scarred gangster. Tienu wants to throw acid at an actress, but a masked acrobat defeats him and exposes him as a poor imitator.

feats.scene: Tienu shoves a glass case over to grab the loose jewels.
Tienu crawls out of rubble after a city quake.

reply.summary: Llviirn is a brown-haired, blue-eyed divorcee who hides her allegiance to a hateful party in a quiet city and lies smoothly. Llviirn relies on deception rather than force.

feats.scene: Llviirn slaps a witness who threatens to talk.
Llviirn stumbles on a stair and catches the rail.

reply.summary: Naval is a brown-haired spy chief who secretly runs shady arms deals in jungle country, then wakes a war deity in a ruined temple that rides her body. Naval uses ancient weapons to capture a ghost and drag it to her headquarters.

feats.scene: Naval fires a relic weapon that snares a wandering ghost.
Naval remains standing as a god is forced out of her body.

reply.summary: Llurer is a black-haired sorceress who gathers and steals fortune from strangers, driven by a feud after her first spell killed her family. Llurer bends odds in her favour, but dies when a duel brings down the building around her.

feats.scene: Llurer twists chance so that every beam in a hall gives way above her rival.
Llurer is buried in falling plaster and does not rise again.

reply.summary: Reslune is a violet-eyed, blond noblewoman of a gem-themed realm who fights with a blade and casts bolts and solid shapes of pure force. Reslune protects her daughter from the shadows and guards a quiet manor house.

feats.scene: Reslune hurls a lance of force that shatters a siege tower.
Reslune shields herself with a solid dome as arrows rain down.

reply.summary: Ceses is a black-haired contract killer mutated by falling space rock, able to vanish from sight, and surprisingly good at cooking. Ceses saves a stranger from a speeding car, then picks the wrong target and is shot dead.

feats.scene: Ceses vanishes in a hallway and strikes a guard from behind.
Ceses takes a bullet and crumples to the floor.

reply.summary: Valore is a grey-skinned, red-eyed demigod who wields a scythe and was born to bring about a prophesied age of death. Valore combines the might of two bloodlines with dark magic, and hunts divine beings across the universe.

feats.scene: Valore tears a moon-sized rift in the sky with a dread blow from her scythe.
Valore wades through a storm of blasts that flatten a mountain range.

reply.summary: Stisiu is a grey-haired, red-eyed goddess with a scythe, hurling beams, moving at great speed and living forever as she rules over doom. Stisiu fights with acrobatic grace, takes her strongest strikes with ease and commands her followers like a general.

feats.scene: Stisiu fires twin beams that melt through an entire fortress.
Stisiu dashes across a cityscape faster than a rifle round.

reply.summary: Vorlerlu is a grey-skinned, black-eyed, hairless youth who turned away from his monstrous father and trained with sword and fist to oppose him. Vorlerlu wields spells, storms a dark stronghold with his half-siblings, and is struck down by his own parent.

feats.scene: Vorlerlu sends a crackling bolt through a rank of guards at the stronghold gate.
Vorlerlu endures a savage swat from his father before finally falling.

reply.summary: Resst is an orange-haired villain in robes who serves a powerful master and clashes with a team of mismatched heroes. Resst commands little beyond a flair for ritual, and he hopes his title will frighten people.

feats.scene: Resst smashes a stone urn onto a hero's shield.
Resst is flung from a doorway and lands on his feet.

reply.summary: Risau is a black-eyed, white-haired matron who commands an army from a harsh orphanage on a burning world. Risau cannot die of age, shrugs off poison, and hits with brutal strength and quick reflexes.

feats.scene: Risau smashes a bunker wall with a single swing of her fist.
Risau drinks a vial of venom and then laughs at the one who offered it.

reply.summary: Ntiianor is a stout, blue-eyed, white-haired drillmistress who ran a cruel training house for a tyrant, shaping children into soldiers through terror. Ntiianor once killed her own beloved pet when ordered, and in return earned her master's grim respect.

feats.scene: Ntiianor flattens a squad of recruits with a stomp that cracks the floor.
Ntiianor stands unscathed amid collapsing barracks.

reply.summary: Torenuval is a white-haired lieutenant of a far-off despot, leading a corps of female warriors with intimidation and coaching. Torenuval has an ageless physique and prefers to teach through fear.

feats.scene: Torenuval tears the hatch off an armoured transport.
Torenuval absorbs a barrage of rockets and sneers.

reply.summary: Niaamian is a green-eyed newspaper editor, grown in a lab and implanted with false memories to believe he is a long-lost brother. Niaamian hires a young reporter, falls in love, and is murdered when he learns his true origin.

feats.scene: Niaamian slams a desk drawer shut on a rival editor's draft.
Niaamian is pushed over a railing and gasps as he lands.

reply.summary: Tiateore is the estranged son of a famous mercenary who copies his father's mask and creed to run a cruel gang in a big city. Tiateore plants bombs to cleanse the wealthy, but a team arriving from a possible future thwarts the plan.

feats.scene: Tiateore plants charges around the financial district meant to flatten a few blocks.
Tiateore takes a hard fall in armour and gets up fighting.

reply.summary: Teantis is a brown-eyed, black-haired criminal who takes the mask of his father and conquers a city in an uprising, killing a hero's allies. Teantis is a skilled swordsman and tactician, brutal in a duel, and is finally defeated by a time-crossing crew.

feats.scene: Teantis cuts off a hero's arm with a single sword stroke.
Teantis takes a heavy blow and stays on his feet.

reply.summary: Anisia is a blond mercenary who idolised a famous killer and let scientists graft his idol's abilities onto his body out of spite. Anisia blames a team of young heroes for his ruined flat and love life, and he dies soon after.

feats.scene: Anisia strikes a hero with enhanced reflexes and knocks him over a car.
Anisia takes a pounding from the whole team and keeps swinging.

reply.summary: Ilvosvau is a red-haired city criminal who dresses in leaping gear and strikes from rooftops at night. Ilvosvau gives himself a bug-themed alias and relies on nimble stunts.

feats.scene: Ilvosvau drops from a rooftop and kicks a guard through a skylight.
Ilvosvau lands from a three-storey jump, wincing.

reply.summary: Valmilral is a yellow-eyed, orange-haired pod-born student who flew through a comet's tail and gained blazing speed, leaving a glowing trail. Valmilral exhales thick clouds that blind enemies or put them to sleep, and talks in endless slang.

feats.scene: Valmilral streaks through a mock enemy fleet and releases a dense cloud that hides her.
Valmilral races a star-cruiser across a vacuum course.

reply.summary: Anuntotel is a grey-eyed, grey-haired sorcerer rewarded by cosmic overseers with the ability to harvest the dream stuff of the dying, using clone helpers to do it. Anuntotel sees every sensation as dull grey, begins to steal from the living, and is taken to his patrons' home plane.

feats.scene: Anuntotel siphons the dreaming energy of an entire village at once.
Anuntotel stands against a whole team of heroes with a clone wall around him.

reply.summary: Ianlorsa is a red-eyed, black-haired, grey-skinned son of a distant tyrant, bulky and impervious to harm. Ianlorsa fights for his father's regime and hits hard enough to crack bedrock.

feats.scene: Ianlorsa pounds a canyon wall and brings a city-sized slab down.
Ianlorsa stands in a firestorm that scorches a whole valley.

reply.summary: Tanmi is a towering grey-skinned, red-eyed son of a cosmic tyrant, resentful of being unacknowledged, who wages a campaign across the galaxy to wipe out worlds and take his father's seat. Tanmi dismantles a galactic police force, but his rampage ends on a single hostile planet.

feats.scene: Tanmi shatters an inhabited world to draw power for his claim.
Tanmi endures the combined fire of a patrol fleet without a scratch.

reply.summary: Riaauma is an orange-and-white furred tiger emperor of a savage future empire, who rules from a ruined metropolis with claws and keen senses. Riaauma leads armies of striped warriors and has a son who will inherit his throne.

feats.scene: Riaauma rakes his claws across a rebel's armour and splits it.
Riaauma shakes off a spear thrust to his side and roars.

reply.summary: Veoiueo is a tiger-headed monarch created in a secret lab, ruling an island empire with his heir, a veteran of old beast wars. Veoiueo survives an assassination attempt and tests a stranger with strange trials before granting him freedom.

feats.scene: Veoiueo slashes a rebel's shield with his claws and sends it flying.
Veoiueo survives an ambush by soldiers and gets up with a snarl.

reply.summary: Raaus is an orange-furred tiger lord who is a bachelor ruler of a wasteland kingdom, fiercely proud and brief in his appearance. Raaus meets his end swiftly, but his reputation as a fighter lingers.

feats.scene: Raaus swipes a claw across a soldier's armour and leaves deep grooves.
Raaus keeps his stance after taking a hard hit.

reply.summary: Letaulle is a green-eyed tiger emperor whose keen senses and claws serve him as he rules an empire and mourns a lost heir. Letaulle leads with an iron will and is ready to join forces with a masked hero.

feats.scene: Letaulle swipes a claw through a wooden barricade and shreds it.
Letaulle takes a heavy blow in battle and growls.

reply.summary: Senanra is a grey-haired ancient sorceress who once led a coven of witches, shaping vast spells of hiding and linking distant rooms through doorways. Senanra has lost her mind and mutters nonsense, but her hands still mimic the motions of knitting.

feats.scene: Senanra stitches a warding veil over a whole district with her mind.
Senanra sits unharmed as a rival unravels her enchantments around her.

reply.summary: Rniluia is a pink-skinned, black-haired lantern in a space police corps, armed with a ring and a will that does not bend. Rniluia shapes light into tools, raises shields, fires beams and flies, but falls in his only appearance.

feats.scene: Rniluia sends a glowing beam through a pirate skiff.
Rniluia tanks a blast with a ring shield, until it fails.

reply.summary: Corllu is a red-eyed, black-haired half-demon who was empowered by his dark father to hunt his half-sister's friends, the greedy one of a band of siblings. Corllu is beaten with his brothers, but his sister later claims the title of pride and turns on them.

feats.scene: Corllu crushes a parked car with a stomp of power.
Corllu stands among rivals' blasts and sneers.

reply.summary: Leniveo is a blond, black-eyed, fanged and clawed bounty hunter who delivers captives to a distant hub and calls himself a keeper of the peace. Leniveo is a master of hunting and archery.

feats.scene: Leniveo looses an arrow that pins a fugitive's cloak to a door.
Leniveo takes a slash from a captive and stays on his feet.

reply.summary: Tassi is a brown-eyed woman with bright green hair who shoots fire and flies, defending her home city in comic fashion. Tassi is a hero who takes the job lightly and often misjudges a rescue.

feats.scene: Tassi hurls a ball of fire that melts a delivery van's tires.
Tassi crashes into a billboard and shakes herself off.

reply.summary: Olleeru is a brown-furred warthog hero in a barnyard team, flying with a ring and calling on a toothy sucker-mouthed fish to terrify foes. Olleeru wins a barn fight by scaring a hippo into surrender.

feats.scene: Olleeru flings a toothy fish at a charging hippo.
Olleeru is trampled in a barn stampede and wobbles up.

reply.summary: Tumlitiu is a pale-skinned guardian of a twilit world, a spectral hero who channels spells rather than a ring's power. Tumlitiu patrols the hush between worlds and answers to no known creed.

feats.scene: Tumlitiu sends a ghostly flare across a graveyard that withers every blossom.
Tumlitiu walks unharmed through a barrage of cursed fire.

reply.summary: Lastron is a red-eyed, brown-haired vampire in a band of blood-drinkers, armed with a ring that builds shapes, shields and beams and lets him fly. Lastron is bound by a will of iron and is hurt by yellow sunlight.

feats.scene: Lastron shapes a glowing stake and drives it into a bat-winged ghoul.
Lastron shrugs off a heavy swing before the sun rises.

reply.summary: Lianau is a green-eyed, black-haired occult heroine of a parallel world, of uncertain origin, said to be a revived dead adventurer or a lantern-keeping sister. Lianau speaks of graves and rising light, and fights on teams of strange allies.

feats.scene: Lianau calls the dead from a cemetery and sends them against a cult.
Lianau stands in a storm of spells and is untouched.

reply.summary: Sanve is a black-and-white-haired young hero of the far future who wields a ring fed by a primal star-fire, inspired by golden-age legends. Sanve forms a new team of heroes, is killed by a time-travelling villain, then restored when the timeline is repaired.

feats.scene: Sanve fires a beam from his ring that melts a battle cruiser's hull.
Sanve is struck by a time-lord's weapon and fades out.

reply.summary: Rusreoma is a black-haired young woman who inherits a lantern's ring and fights alongside famous heroes against a mad titan. Rusreoma shapes light into tools and flies through the sky with unflinching willpower.

feats.scene: Rusreoma builds a giant glowing hammer and smashes a siege machine.
Rusreoma is struck by a thrown boulder and slides across the ground.

reply.summary: Iarli is a grey-skinned, red-eyed, hairless lantern from a distant species, stationed at a central citadel and armed with a ring that builds, shields, shoots and flies. Iarli dies in a last desperate stand against a tyrant's attack.

feats.scene: Iarli fires a ring beam at the tyrant's advance guard.
Iarli holds a glowing shield against a bright red beam until it breaks.

reply.summary: Aseonnt is a grey-skinned, hairless lantern of a distant species in a space police corps, with a will of iron and a ring that builds shapes, shields, beams and wings. Aseonnt fights alongside his comrades in a mission across the stars.

feats.scene: Aseonnt shapes a glowing cage around a smuggler's ship and crushes it.
Aseonnt holds against a barrage behind a bright ring shield.
